Thank you to you and your child for participating in this research project!

The following survey will take approximately 20-30 minutes to complete and will ask questions about your child.

When answering the questions, please think about your child who is participating in this research project. If you have more than one child participating in the research project, you will complete this survey separately for each participating child.

Some questions will note a specific timeframe to consider when answering. If no timeframe is indicated, you can think about how the answer applies to your child in general.

We appreciate you answering as completely and accurately as possible with the information you have available to you. If you have questions about this survey, please reach out to the research coordinator.

When you are ready to begin, select the “start survey” button.

Thank you!
target_text:

Think of this line as representing where people stand in the country where you live.

To the right are the people who are the best off - those who have the most money, the most education, and the most respected jobs.

To the left are the people who are the worst off - those who have the least money, the least education, the least respected jobs, or no job.

The further to the right you are on the line, the closer you are to the people at the very top; the further to the left you are, the closer you are to the people at the very bottom.

Where would you place yourself on this line?

Move the slider to where you think you stand at this time in your life relative to other people in your country.
target_text:
Instructies:

Beschouw deze lijn als een weergave van de positie van mensen in het land waar u woont. Aan de rechterzijde bevinden zich de mensen die het beste af zijn - degenen met het meeste geld, het hoogste opleidingsniveau en de meest gewaardeerde beroepen.

Aan de linkerzijde bevinden zich de mensen die het slechste af zijn - degenen met het minste geld, het laagste opleidingsniveau, de minst gewaardeerde beroepen, of zonder baan.

Hoe verder naar rechts u zich op de lijn bevindt, hoe dichter u bij de mensen aan de absolute top bent; hoe verder naar links u zich bevindt, hoe dichter u bij de mensen aan de absolute onderkant bent.

Waar zou u uzelf op deze lijn plaatsen?

Beweeg de schuifregelaar naar de positie waarvan u denkt dat deze uw huidige levenssituatie weergeeft ten opzichte van andere mensen in uw land.

Thank you to you and your child for participating in this research project!

The following survey will take approximately 20-30 minutes to complete and will ask questions about your child.

When answering the questions, please think about your child who is participating in this research project. If you have more than one child participating in the research project, you will complete this survey separately for each participating child.

Some questions will note a specific timeframe to consider when answering. If no timeframe is indicated, you can think about how the answer applies to your child in general.

We appreciate you answering as completely and accurately as possible with the information you have available to you. If you have questions about this survey, please reach out to the research coordinator.

When you are ready to begin, select the “start survey” button.

Thank you!

source_text:
We are interested how often, independently, and easily your child shows each behavior when occasions call for it. Children who excel at a specific behavior should receive 4 (the highest rating), whereas most children will be between 3 and 2. Those who are still developing and need a lot of support should receive a rating of 1.

4 = Always on their own (No support needed)
3 = Mostly on their own (Brief reminders or support)
2 = Sometimes on their own (Regular reminders or moderate support needed)
1 = Not able on their own (Requires a lot of support)
target_text:
Nous nous intéressons à la fréquence, à l’autonomie et à la facilité avec lesquelles votre enfant manifeste chaque comportement lorsque les circonstances l’exigent. Les enfants qui excellent dans un comportement spécifique devraient recevoir la note 4 (la plus élevée), tandis que la plupart des enfants auront entre 3 et 2. Ceux qui sont encore en développement et ont besoin de beaucoup de soutien devraient recevoir la note 1.
4 = Toujours par lui-même (aucun soutien nécessaire)

Instructions:

Think of this line as representing where people stand in the country where you live.

To the right are the people who are the best off - those who have the most money, the most education, and the most respected jobs.

To the left are the people who are the worst off - those who have the least money, the least education, the least respected jobs, or no job.

source_text: With this set of items, we wish to learn more about teachers' ideas and beliefs about children.
target_text: Avec cet ensemble d’éléments, nous souhaitons en savoir plus sur les idées et les croyances des enseignants concernant les enfants.

source_text: Please select one answer that indicates how strongly you agree with each of the following statements.
target_text: Veuillez sélectionner une réponse qui indique à quel point vous êtes d’accord avec chacun des énoncés suivants.

source_text: Since parents lack special training in education, they should not question the teacher's teaching methods.
target_text: Étant donné que les parents n’ont pas de formation spéciale en éducation, ils ne devraient pas remettre en question les méthodes pédagogiques de l’enseignant.

source_text: Children should be treated the same regardless of differences among them.
target_text: Les enfants devraient être traités de la même manière, quelles que soient leurs différences.

source_text: Children should always obey the teacher.
target_text: Les élèves devraient toujours obéir à l’enseignant.

source_text: Preparing for the future is more important for a child than enjoying today.
target_text: Se préparer pour l’avenir est plus important pour un enfant que de profiter du moment présent.

source_text: Children will not do the right thing unless they must.
target_text: Les enfants ne feront pas ce qui est juste à moins qu’ils ne soient obligés.

source_text: Children should be allowed to disagree with their parents if they feel their own ideas are better.
target_text: Les enfants devraient avoir le droit d'être en désaccord avec leurs parents s’ils pensent que leurs idées sont meilleures.

source_text: Children should be kept busy with work and study at home and at school.
target_text: Les enfants devraient être occupés par le travail et l’étude à la maison et à l’école.

source_text: The major goal of education is to put basic information into the minds of the children.
target_text: L'objectif principal de l’éducation est de transmettre des connaissances de base aux enfants.

source_text: In order to be fair, a teacher must treat all children alike.
target_text: Pour être juste, un enseignant doit traiter tous les enfants de la même manière.

source_text: The most important thing to teach children is absolute obedience to whoever is in authority.
target_text: La chose la plus importante à enseigner aux enfants est l’obéissance absolue envers ceux qui sont en position d’autorité.

source_text: Children learn best by doing things themselves rather than listening to others.
target_text: Les enfants apprennent mieux en faisant eux-mêmes les choses plutôt qu’en écoutant les autres.

source_text: Children must be carefully trained early in life or their natural impulses will make them unmanageable.
target_text: Les enfants doivent être soigneusement éduqués dès leur jeune âge , sinon leurs impulsions naturelles les rendront ingérables.

source_text: Children have a right to their own point of view and should be allowed to express it.
target_text: Les enfants ont le droit d'avoir leur propre point de vue et devraient pouvoir l’exprimer.

source_text: Children's learning results mainly from being presented basic information again and again.
target_text: L’apprentissage des enfants résulte principalement de la présentation répétée d’informations de base.

source_text: Children like to teach other children.
target_text: Les enfants aiment enseigner aux enfants.

source_text: The most important thing to teach children is absolute obedience to parents.
target_text: La chose la plus importante à enseigner aux enfants est l’obéissance absolue aux parents.

We are interested how often, independently, and easily your child shows each behavior when occasions call for it. Children who excel at a specific behavior should receive 4 (the highest rating), whereas most children will be between 3 and 2. Those who are still developing and need a lot of support should receive a rating of 1.

4 = Always on their own (No support needed)
3 = Mostly on their own (Brief reminders or support)
2 = Sometimes on their own (Regular reminders or moderate support needed)
1 = Not able on their own (Requires a lot of support)

Instructions:

Think of this line as representing where people stand in the country where you live.

To the right are the people who are the best off - those who have the most money, the most education, and the most respected jobs.

To the left are the people who are the worst off - those who have the least money, the least education, the least respected jobs, or no job.

The further to the right you are on the line, the closer you are to the people at the very top; the further to the left you are, the closer you are to the people at the very bottom.

Where would you place yourself on this line?

source_text:
Thank you to you and your child for participating in this research project!

The following survey will take approximately 20-30 minutes to complete and will ask questions about your child.

When answering the questions, please think about your child who is participating in this research project. If you have more than one child participating in the research project, you will complete this survey separately for each participating child.

Some questions will note a specific timeframe to consider when answering. If no timeframe is indicated, you can think about how the answer applies to your child in general.

We appreciate you answering as completely and accurately as possible with the information you have available to you. If you have questions about this survey, please reach out to the research coordinator.

When you are ready to begin, select the “start survey” button.

Thank you!
target_text:
¡Gracias a usted y a su hijo/a por participar en este proyecto de investigación!
Completar la siguiente encuesta le tomará aproximadamente 20-30 minutos. Se le harán preguntas sobre su hijo/a.

Al responder las preguntas, por favor piense en su hijo/a que está participando en este proyecto de investigación. Si tiene más de un/a hijo/a participando en el proyecto, deberá completar esta encuesta por separado para cada uno/a.

Algunas preguntas indicarán un período de tiempo específico que deberá tener en cuenta al responder. Si no se indica ningún período, puede pensar cómo se aplica la pregunta a su hijo/a en general.

Le agradecemos que responda la encuesta de la manera más completa y precisa posible con la información que tiene disponible. Si tiene alguna pregunta sobre esta encuesta, por favor comuníquese con la persona coordinadora de la investigación.

We are interested how often, independently, and easily your child shows each behavior when occasions call for it. Children who excel at a specific behavior should receive 4 (the highest rating), whereas most children will be between 3 and 2. Those who are still developing and need a lot of support should receive a rating of 1.

4 = Always on their own (No support needed)
3 = Mostly on their own (Brief reminders or support)
2 = Sometimes on their own (Regular reminders or moderate support needed)
1 = Not able on their own (Requires a lot of support)
target_text:
Nos interesa saber con qué frecuencia, independencia y facilidad su niño/a despliega estos comportamientos cuando la ocasión lo requiere. Los niños que sobresalen en un comportamiento específico deberían recibir una calificación de 4 (la puntuación más alta). La mayoría de niños recibirán calificaciones de 3 ó 2. Quienes aún están en desarrollo y requieren mucha ayuda deberían recibir una calificación de 1.

4 = Siempre por sí mismo/a (no necesita apoyo)

Instructions:

Think of this line as representing where people stand in the country where you live.

To the right are the people who are the best off - those who have the most money, the most education, and the most respected jobs.

To the left are the people who are the worst off - those who have the least money, the least education, the least respected jobs, or no job.

The further to the right you are on the line, the closer you are to the people at the very top; the further to the left you are, the closer you are to the people at the very bottom.

Where would you place yourself on this line?

Move the slider to where you think you stand at this time in your life relative to other people in your country.

Piense que esta línea representa la situación de la gente en el país en el que vive.

A la derecha están las personas más acomodadas: las que tienen más dinero, más educación y los trabajos más respetados.

A la izquierda están las personas que están en peor situación: las que tienen menos dinero, menos educación, los trabajos menos respetados o ningún trabajo.

Cuanto más a la derecha se encuentre en la línea, más cerca estará de la gente que más tiene; cuanto más a la izquierda, más cerca estará de la gente que menos tiene.

¿Dónde se situaría usted en esta línea?

source_text:
Thank you to you and your child for participating in this research project!

The following survey will take approximately 20-30 minutes to complete and will ask questions about your child.

When answering the questions, please think about your child who is participating in this research project. If you have more than one child participating in the research project, you will complete this survey separately for each participating child.

Some questions will note a specific timeframe to consider when answering. If no timeframe is indicated, you can think about how the answer applies to your child in general.

We appreciate you answering as completely and accurately as possible with the information you have available to you. If you have questions about this survey, please reach out to the research coordinator.

When you are ready to begin, select the “start survey” button.

Thank you!
target_text:
¡Gracias a usted y a su niño(a) por participar en este proyecto de investigación!
Estimamos que diligenciar la siguiente encuesta le tomará aproximadamente 20-30 minutos. En la encuesta se le harán preguntas sobre su niño(a).

Si tiene más de un niño(a) y solo uno participa en el proyecto de investigación, responda a las preguntas pensando únicamente en ese niño(a). Si tiene más de un(a) niño(a) y más de uno(a) participa en el proyecto de investigación, debe diligenciar esta encuesta por separado para cada niño(a) participante.

En algunas preguntas se indica un marco temporal específico que debe tenerse en cuenta al responder. Si no se indica ningún marco temporal, puede pensar en cómo se aplica la respuesta a usted o a su niño(a) en general.

Le agradecemos que responda la encuesta de la forma más precisa posible con la información de que dispone. Si tiene alguna duda, comuníquesela a quien apoya esta aplicación.

Cuando esté listo(a) para empezar, seleccione el botón "Comenzar Encuesta".

¡Muchas gracias!

Instructions:

Think of this line as representing where people stand in the country where you live.

To the right are the people who are the best off - those who have the most money, the most education, and the most respected jobs.

To the left are the people who are the worst off - those who have the least money, the least education, the least respected jobs, or no job.

source_text: With this set of items, we wish to learn more about teachers' ideas and beliefs about children.
target_text: Con el siguiente grupo de preguntas deseamos conocer las ideas y creencias de los docentes sobre los niños(as).

source_text: Please select one answer that indicates how strongly you agree with each of the following statements.
target_text: Por favor, seleccione una respuesta que indique hasta qué punto usted está de acuerdo con cada una de las siguientes afirmaciones.

source_text: Since parents lack special training in education, they should not question the teacher's teaching methods.
target_text: Dado que los padres carecen de formación especial en educación, no deberían cuestionar los métodos de enseñanza del docente.

source_text: Children should be treated the same regardless of differences among them.
target_text: Los niños(as) deben recibir el mismo trato a pesar de sus diferencias.

source_text: Children should always obey the teacher.
target_text: Los niños(as) siempre deben obedecer al docente.

source_text: Preparing for the future is more important for a child than enjoying today.
target_text: Prepararse para el futuro es más importante para un niño(a) que disfrutar del presente.

source_text: Children will not do the right thing unless they must.
target_text: Los niños(as) no harán lo correcto a menos que tengan que hacerlo.

source_text: Children should be allowed to disagree with their parents if they feel their own ideas are better.
target_text: Los niños(as) deberían poder estar en desacuerdo con sus padres si creen que sus ideas son mejores.

source_text: Children should be kept busy with work and study at home and at school.
target_text: Los niños(as) deberían mantenerse ocupados con tareas y estudio en la casa y en el colegio.

source_text: The major goal of education is to put basic information into the minds of the children.
target_text: El principal objetivo de la educación es introducir información básica en la mente de los niños(as).

source_text: In order to be fair, a teacher must treat all children alike.
target_text: Para ser justo, un docente debe tratar a todos los niños(as) por igual.

source_text: The most important thing to teach children is absolute obedience to whoever is in authority.
target_text: La lección más importante para enseñarle a un niño(a) es obediencia absoluta a quien tiene la autoridad.

source_text: Children learn best by doing things themselves rather than listening to others.
target_text: Los niños(as) aprenden mejor haciendo las cosas ellos(as) mismos(as) que escuchando a otros(as).

source_text: Children must be carefully trained early in life or their natural impulses will make them unmanageable.
target_text: Los niños(as) deben ser entrenados(as) cuidadosamente desde muy pequeños o sus impulsos naturales los harán inmanejables.

source_text: Children have a right to their own point of view and should be allowed to express it.
target_text: Los niños(as) tienen derecho a tener su propio punto de vista y se les debe permitir expresarlo.

source_text: Children's learning results mainly from being presented basic information again and again.
target_text: El aprendizaje en los niños(as) resulta de que se les presente información básica una y otra vez.

source_text: Children like to teach other children.
target_text: A los niños(as) les gusta enseñarle a otros niños(as).

source_text: The most important thing to teach children is absolute obedience to parents.
target_text: Lo más importante que hay que enseñar a los niños(as) es la obediencia absoluta a los padres.
